summary: Shadow Bolt Destruction with Conflagrate (Immolate kept), Shadow and Flame 5/5 and Fire and Brimstone, plus Pandemic and Malevolence from Affliction. Succubus out. The best 30-point Destruction build.
rotation: Pre-pull: Shadow Bolt at -2.5s (lands just after the pull)
Life Tap below 5% mana or when the filler costs more than the mana left
Bane of Doom when it lands before the fight ends (more than 60s left)
Bane of Agony while Bane of Doom is on cooldown or would not land
Corruption when it is down (more than 9s left)
Immolate when down or when less than its cast time remains
Conflagrate on cooldown while Immolate is up
Death Coil, then Searing Pain, when the filler would not land before the fight ends
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets: 38 spell power and 13 crit rating, and an on-use 140 spell power for 20s every 2 min (at the pull, then on cooldown).
Demon sensitivity: no owner scaling 946.1, Succubus melee halved 947.4, both 922.9 (first set)
Succubus 984.9 vs Felhunter 960.1, Imp 950.7, no demon 895.4; Spellstone and Firestone within 0.1 (first set)
Demon scaling uses Season of Discovery placeholder coefficients (Forever's are server side). Worth 49 on Demonology and 39 on the other builds.
Succubus base melee is unverified. Halving it would cost Demonology 43 and the other builds 38 to 39.
Bane of Doom's coefficient is 4.0 (Era 1.0), about 12% of Shadow Bolt builds' damage. At 2.0 they lose about 4%, at 1.0 about 6%.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Shadow Bolt IX, Immolate VII, Corruption VI). These are 7 to 13 DPS below ranks X, VIII and VII.
Only the Demonheart Raiment 2-piece is live (the 5-piece added about +8 to +13 on the first set)
Soul shards and Life Tap's health cost aren't tracked.
Demons use the warlock's spell crit as their own melee and spell crit, with no crit of their own (Blizzard's intent, forever-bugs #331). Worth 15 to 17 DPS.
notes: Request straight from mksettings -spec destruction -gear level60_phase1_synthetic -apl level60_destruction -race Human -duration 180, no edits. Demon Armor; Summon Succubus, sacrificed NoSummon, imbue Spellstone. mksettings sets distanceFromTarget 5 / channelClipDelayMs 50 where the UI preset uses 25 / 150; the published numbers were made with mksettings and reproduce exactly.
